Spell Kit

New Moon Manifestation Kit

Everything for a simple new moon intention ritual, gathered in one small box: a candle, two tumbled stones, a pouch to keep them in, parchment for your written intention, a pinch of lavender, and a printed card that walks you through the ritual step by step. The ritual is yours to do in your own way — this kit simply gathers the pieces. It is a spiritual and creative practice aid; it makes no medical claims and promises no particular outcome.

  • 1 black chime candle
  • 1 tumbled moonstone
  • 1 tumbled clear quartz
  • 1 purple velvet drawstring pouch (3"x4")
  • 1 aged parchment sheet
  • A pinch of dried lavender
  • 1 printed quick-start ritual card

How it works: each kit is assembled by hand when you order. Components are ordered per order, so please allow about a week for handling before your kit ships.

Reiki

Distance reiki, wherever you are.

Reiki is a gentle Japanese energy-healing practice. In a distance session, you rest comfortably in your own space while the practitioner works with the same techniques used in person — no travel, no video call required.

How a session works

Quiet support, sent with intention.

Book by email and share what you'd like the session to hold space for — rest, grief, a hard season, or simply a reset. At the scheduled time, find a quiet place to lie down or sit, and the session is held for you from a distance. Afterwards you'll receive a short note by email with anything that came up and a suggestion for the days ahead.

  • Sessions are booked by email inquiry — tell us a little about what you need and we'll reply with times and current rates.
  • Choose a 30-minute session for a gentle reset, or 60 minutes for deeper rest.
  • You'll get a follow-up email after your session with notes and reflections.
  • Reiki is a complementary wellness practice — a support for rest and reflection, not a replacement for medical or mental-health care.

Book a distance session

Email to ask about availability, current rates, and what to expect. There's no obligation — ask anything you'd like to know first.

Email to Book — carleylenon@gmail.com

Reiki is offered for relaxation and spiritual well-being. It does not diagnose or treat illness and is not a substitute for professional medical, legal, or mental-health care.
